generalCriterionList.description: Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
Tenderers shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by any State Government / Government of India /Union Territory.

The tenderer is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at tenderers end.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

It shall be the responsibility of the tenderer to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
The original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of tender process as and when sought for, failing which, the bids are liable for disqualification.
Rates shall be quoted in price schedule in the website itself.
The tender shall be valid for 180 days from the last date of submission of bid.
The tender document is part and parcel of the agreement
Conditional tenders are liable for rejection.
The tenderer shall comply all the GST requirements.

The contractor shall quote his rates inclusive of PF as per the applicable rate as issued by the PF department from time to time and if any variation occurs it shall be paid / refunded by / to the Corporation against documentary evidence.
The successful tenderer shall give an undertaking that they would abide by the provisions of the Employees Provident Fund Act.
The tenderer shall obtain insurance coverage for all the workers deployed for this work.
The tenderer shall quote his rates exclusive of GST and all other applicable taxes, levies, duties etc., as per the latest GoK and GoI prevailing as on the date of opening of financial bid.
KPCL shall recover the Income Tax at the prevailing applicable rates.

If the successful bidder/agency fails to furnish documents related to remittance royalty charges while quoting their rates and shall be deducted from the work bills. The successful bidder shall strictly adhere to Rule 36& 42 of Karnataka Mineral Concession Rules 1994 & its amendments thereof

If the successful bidder/agency fails to furnish document related to remittance of royalty charges of Coarse Aggregates, Fine aggregates Murrum etc., as per Rule 44(4) of Karnatakka Mineral Concession (Amendment) Rules 2016, following penalty will be recovered from the work bills.

The tenderer should maintain register of workers deployed and wages paid for the workers and shall produce the documents whenever called for by the competent authority. Remittance towards PF shall be commensurate with the labour component of the work involved.
In case the dates notified above declared as holiday, the immediate next working day will be reckoned.
Tenderer should have independent PF code.The tenderer shall remit PF of labourers to Contractors permanent PF code number only and not to the KPCL PF sub code
If the tenderer makes any alterations in the conditions of the contract or puts any condition of his own, such tenders are liable for rejection
Further details of the work or any clarifications can be obtained from the office of the Executive Engineer (PCM)/ BTPS, KPCL, Kudithini-58315, during office hours. Mobile- 91-9448290702
Any variation in labour wages made by the Government from time to time shall be borne by the agency. Any claim towards this variation will not be entertained by KPCL.

In case of death of a contractor after executing the agreement/commencement of the work, his legal heir (to be intimated at the time of execution of agreement by the successful contractor), if any eligible registered contractor and willing, can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work after obtaining approval from competent authority.

The successful renderer shall furnish a Contract performance guarantee (CPG)/Security deposit (SD) equivalent to 5% of the contract price in the form of e-BG from any schedule bank acceptable to the Corporation in the prescribed format within 20 days of receipt of acceptance letter from KPCL. The validity of e-BG should be contract period plus three months or e-BG shall be extended until the final bill passed by the division. And shall execute the agreement within scheduled time, failing which will attract penalty.

technicalCriterionList.description: Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded

Proposals for subcontracting components of works amounting to more than 20% of the contract price (for each, the qualifications and experience of the identified sub-contractor in the relevant fields should be attached)

The tenderer should have achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs.35.03 lakhs in the last five financial years (ie.2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 2024-25 and 2025-26). Turnover certificate duly certified by the chartered accountant shall be furnished. (Financial Turnover of previous years shall be given Weightage of 10% per year to bring them to present price level of the financial year in which tenders are invited)

The tenderer should have satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor at least one Similar work such as Maintenance of MS /PCCP Pipeline of Dia not less than 1300 mm & for a minimum length of 37.00 Km of value not less than Rs.17.515 Lakhs in any one year in the last five financial years (ie.2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 2024-25 and 2025-26). The work done certificate issued from state/central Government/Government under taking/Public sector undertaking from officers not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent cadre shall be furnished. (Work done value of previous years will shall be given Weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of present financial year, in which tenders are invited).

technicalCriterionList.description: Any individual/ reputed company registered as KPWD Class-III and above contractor is eligible to apply and certificate issued in this regard shall be uploaded.
The intending tenderer shall upload the scanned copies of PAN registration.
The intending tenderer shall upload the scanned copies of PF registration.
The intending tenderer shall upload the scanned copies of GST registration.
The declarations as mentioned in the tender document shall be uploaded.

Assessed available tender capacity (AxNx2.5-B) should be greater than the amount put to tender, where, A-Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years (updated to 2026-27) price level taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N-Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited. B - Value, at 2026-27 price level, of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 6 months. Note: The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent or with self-declaration duly signed by the bidder. The signed copy of available tender capacity calculation sheet shall be uploaded.
Duly filled qualification information as per section-3 along with supporting documents

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Maintenance of Narayanapura pipe line from Intake Pump house near Marol village to Raw water pond at BTPS (Approx length 169.00 kms) upto May-2027

itemList.description: Repairing Air release valves by replacing spares such as balls, gasket etc., by removing precast slab covers placed over the chamber  including operation like dewatering of chamber, cutting of damaged bolts & nuts  wherever necessary, transportation of men and materials to site  including cost of all spares (gaskets, bolts & nuts) and machineries like  dewatering pumps, gas cutting equipments, oxygen cylinders, gas and re- placing the removed precast slabs over the chambers after repair etc., complete with all lead and lifts and as directed by the Engineer in charge.

Repairing buterfly valves by replacing spares such as bolts, gasket etc., by removing precast slab covers placed over the chamber  including operation like dewatering of chamber, cutting of damaged bolts & nuts  wherever necessary, transportation of men and materials to site  including cost of  all spares (gaskets, bolts & nuts) machineries like  dewatering pumps, gas cutting equipments, oxygen cylinders, gas and re- placing the removed precast slabs over the chambers after repair etc., complete with all lead and lifts and as directed by the Engineer in charge

Welding the damaged/crack in pipe line joints/door by using E7018 welding electrodes including  dewatering, removing the over burden soil by mechanical/manual means, cleaning & grinding the surface, cutting the plate for bracing/pin holes/patch to suit the site condition and painting for MS pipes with primer and coaltar  paint or plastering the open surface with CM 1:4 to match with guintted  thickness and back filling the trench after successful testing of joint by DPT including  the cost of all machineries like welding set, welding transformer, DG set of required capacity, dewatering pumps, gas cutting equipments, oxygen cylinders, gas, transportation charges of all materials & machineries, cost of consumables such as grinding wheel, cable etc., complete with all lead and lifts  and as directed by the Engineer in charge.

Welding the damaged/crack in pipe line joints/door by using E7018 welding electrodes, cleaning & grinding the surface, cutting the plate for bracing/pin holes/patch to suit the site condition and  painting for MS pipes with primer and coaltar  paint plastering the open surface with CM 1:4 to match with guintted  thickness and  successful testing of joint by DPT including  the cost of all machineries like welding set, welding transformer, DG set of required capacity, gas cutting equipments, oxygen cylinders, gas, transportation charges of all materials & machineries, cost of consumables such as grinding wheel, cable etc., complete with all lead and lifts  and as directed by the Engineer in charge.

Operation of Butterfly vlaves of MS & PCCP pipeline  from Narayanapura Intake pump house at marol village to Raw water pond at BTPS  for isolation of water inside pipeline, by removing precast slab covers placed over the chamber  including closing & opening of valves and dewatering wherever necessary, transportation of men and materials to site and re-placing the removed precast slabs over the chambers after repair etc., complete with all lead and lifts and as directed by the Engineer in charge.

Dewatering chambers of Air release valve, Butter fly valves , Zero velocity valves and pipe line in Narayanapur pipeline from Intake pumphouse near To BTPS  by using  diesel pumps of 10 Hp capacity including DPOL & crew with all lead and lifts etc., complete and as directed by the Engineer in-charge.

Providing online Welding  to MS pipeline leakages by (graphite filling )  pneumatic method using pnumatic drilling machine, pinning machine, hydraulic pumps, graphite compound, rubber metallic compound, air compressor, including transporation, men, machineries & materials complete with all lead and lifts and as per the direction of engineer in charge.

Providing online Welding  to MS pipeline leakages (Small cracks of 2mm to 3mm wide & length upto  300mm) by  pneumatic method using pneumatic drilling machine, pining machine, hydraulic pumps, graphite compound, rubber metallic compound, FRP materials,oxygen cyclinder, including transporation, men, machineries & materials complete with all lead and lifts and as per the direction of engineer in charge.

Patrolling of existing Ms & PCCP pipeline  from Narayanapura Intake pump house at marol village to Raw water pond at BTPS (appox 169 kms) in two shifts using motor bike, observing the leakage of water from the pipeline, ARVs, MHs, BFVs and ZVVs daily, submitting daily patrolling report by informing or messaging to the concerned engineer over mobile about the leakages inculding hire charges and maintenance of motor bike, fuel expenses, mobile charges, observers salary etc.,  complete with all lead and lifts...

Dewatering chambers and attending small leakages from Air release valve, MH valve, Butter fly valves & Zero velocity valves in Narayanapura pipe line from Intake Pump house near marol to Raw water pond at BTPS  by using  diesel pumps of 5 Hp capacity including DPOL & crew with all lead and lifts etc., complete and as directed by the Engineer in-charge.

Earth work excavation by manual means upto 1.50m depth for drains,canals, waste weir draft, approach channels, key trench, foundation of Bridges and such similar works in all kinds of soils , as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, removal of stumps and other deleterious matter, excavated surface leveled and sides neatly dressed disposing off the excavated stuff or sorting & stacking the selected stuff for reuse including cost of labour, tools & other appurtenaces required to complete the work with all lead and lifts.

Earth work excavation in all kinds of soils for Foundation by mechanical means upto 3.0m depth for all works & depths, as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth for reuse including cost of labour, tools, usage of machinery & other appurtenaces required to complete the work with all leads and lifts. in all kind of soil depth upto 3.0m

Removing silt, slush, debris and dumped materials from ARV, MH, ZVV, Butterfly valve Chambers of Narayanapura pipeline from Intake  pumphouse to BTPS  etc., by mechanical means/manually including multiple handling wherever necessary and stacking etc., complete with all leads & lifts

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for levelling course for all works in foundation. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using  plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing, and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. Mix 1:2:4 Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for all Foundation works.The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticizers laid in finished layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials, quality confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. M25 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates

Supplying, fitting and placing TMT FE 550 / 550D Steel reinforcement including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire/soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification including loading, unloading, all leads and lifts

Raking out joints of stone masonry surface to the required width and depth, with due care and precaution, by mechanical / manual means, including preparing and cleaning the surface for re-pointing/ refilling of joints, including disposal of rubbish to the dumping ground to nearest area.

Providing and laying  Reinforced Cement Concrete pipe light duty NP2 for culverts, roadway utilities& crossingsas per IS 458:2003 in Single row including pointing ends and fixing collars with cement mortar 1:2 including cost of all materials, labour, curing completeas per  Specifications.-300mm dia

Refilling available earth around trenches/pipelines, cables in layers not exceeding 20 cms in depth, compacting each deposited layer by ramming after watering with a all lead and lifts including cost of all labour complete as per specifications

Providing, supplying and spreading the soil manually in erroded area of agriculural fields/private lands formed due to leakage in pipe line/ARVs inculding the cost of all materrials, machineries and labours etc., complete with all lead and lifts.

Providing Random rubble masonry with hard stone in foundation and plinth including levelling up with cement concrete 1:6:12 (1 cement : 6 coarse sand : 12 graded stone aggregate 20 mm nominal size) upto plinth level with : Cement mortar 1:6 (1  ement : 6 coarse sand)

Placing of  fallen precast RCC cover  slabs over the valve chambers of pipeline wherever required including transporting, lifting and cost of all materials, machineries and labours etc., complete with all lead and lifts.
Renewing glass panes, with putty and nails wherever necessary including racking out the old putty:  1)Float glass panes of  nominal thickness 4 mm (weight not less than 10kg/m²)
Painting with black anti-corrosive bitumastic paint of approved brand  and manufacture to give an even shade :One coats on old work as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer in charge.

Finishing with Epoxy paint (two coats) at all locations prepared and applied as per manufacturer's specifications including appropriate priming coat, preparation of surface, etc. complete. On steel work including preparing the surface after thorougly cleaning oil, grease, dirt and foreign matter, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Enginer-in-charge.
